rules.title: How to Play
rules.gameObjectiveText: Quantum Gate Card Game is an educational card game that teaches quantum computing concepts. Place cards from your hand onto the board in the correct order. The first player to empty their hand wins.
rules.gateCardDesc: I, X, Z, H gates represent quantum operations.
rules.unitaryCardDesc: Special card that reverses turn order.
rules.measurementCardDesc: Measures quantum states and awards points.
rules.controlCardDesc: Advanced card that links with cards in adjacent lanes.
rules.basicRule1: Each player plays one card from their hand per turn
rules.basicRule2: Cards must be placed according to quantum physics rules
rules.basicRule4: Unitary cards reverse the turn order
rules.basicRule5: The first player to empty their hand wins
rules.placementRule1: Gate cards can be placed after other gate cards
rules.placementRule2: Qubit cards can be placed after measurement cards or I gates
rules.placementRule3: Measurement cards can only be placed after qubit cards
rules.placementRule4: Unitary cards cannot be placed after measurement cards
rules.placementRule5: Control cards target cards in adjacent lanes
